title: Noticiero cinematográfico Colombia al día: casas esféricas, erradicación de la malaria, VIII Vuelta a Colombia — "…spherical houses, malaria eradication, 8th Tour of Colombia"
notes: Colombia, Spanish: DINAPE state newsreel, 21 Nov 1957. Windows: the Colombia al Día masthead and 'Noticias de la semana'; the Avianca arrival at San Andrés; a film crew's camera at Zipaquirá; LONG — the German spherical houses, 4.5 m domes being bought by the Belgian Congo, craned down, entered, lived in (a man takes coffee and a newspaper inside one); the Tepexpan skull; the VIII Vuelta a Colombia on the road. Fetched from RTVC's own Señal Memoria YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m36XxYB43AY); cut from a de-watermarked crop (crop=667:500:317:90) removing the Señal Memoria bug and the burned-in ARCHIVO CINEMATECA INRAVISION caption bar
